grid: EPSG:6933 1000m tiles clipped to the fixed geographic ROI
inventory: Original UTF-8 CMR page bytes, hashes, stable CMR-Hits and continuous SearchAfter tokens for every explicit standard mask/geolocation product/version. Zero-hit verified searches differ from missing searches. Inventory is candidate geometry, not pixel support. Companion-only candidates without matching mask acquisitions retain unknown evidence rather than no-candidate/no-pass.
geometry: Explicit source-hash-bound provider-boundary transcription; no centre interpolation. Independent reviewer verifies provider origin and completeness of all intersecting native boundaries. Polygon calculations alone do not establish authenticity.
quality: Original aligned class, latitude/longitude, raw flag, fill metadata, file hashes and dimensions re-extracted. Only raw zero flag excluding known fill supports experimental known geometric states; unknown fill, nonzero flags, partial/overlapping/conflicting support and UTC date ambiguity stay unknown. Independent processing/geometry review is required for validated opportunity.
review: Human processing/geometry reviewer, owner-verified identity, exact frame hashes and explicit native/FIRMS collection mapping. Positive, clear, cloud, unusable and missing/unknown examples across the reviewed campaign. Disagree/unresolved outcomes retain the closed gate. AI and synthetic review never qualify opportunity.
no_pass: No-candidate remains unknown unless a separate independently checked no-pass example, complete original inventory and adequate candidate geometry are all supported.
regional: Every UTC date and clipped ROI grid cell accounted for without overlapping tiles; missing tiles/dates add unknown area. Pilot scope never qualifies a region. Area-weighted known/unknown categories; no independent-cell uncertainty assumption.
transfer: Regional report documents measured opportunity changes only. A separate versioned direct-transfer protocol and independent conclusions must assess applicability, unknown support, seasons and platforms. No historical bridge admitted by this protocol.
